# netbox_ipsec_proposal (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/ipsecproposal/):

> An IPsec proposal defines the algorithms that are used in the second phase of an IPsec negotiation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_ipsec_proposal" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `authentication_algorithm` (String) One of [hmac-sha1, hmac-sha256, hmac-sha384, hmac-sha512, hmac-md5].
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `encryption_algorithm` (String) One of [aes-128-cbc, aes-128-gcm, aes-192-cbc, aes-192-gcm, aes-256-cbc, aes-256-gcm, 3des-cbc, des-cbc].
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `sa_lifetime_data` (Number) Security association lifetime (in kilobytes).
- `sa_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Security association lifetime (seconds).
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
